programs.title: RateEscape: Stop Overpaying For Cellular
programs.desc: Cut up to half the cost of your monthly cell phone bill; same towers, same coverage, but a lot less money; it sounds great but is it too good to be true?; join myth-busting legend Kari Byron as she takes on Big Wireless to save you money.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes
programs.desc: Rachael and her friend, TV host and cookbook author Anna Francese Gass, are preparing a delicious feast together in Rachael's Tuscan kitchen. First, Rachael creates a dish inspired by cucina povera, featuring a hearty bean base, roasted onions, greens, and more. Next, Anna demonstrates how to make Panadas, Italian-style empanadas filled with vegetables, lamb, and cheese, all wrapped in a perfectly crisp pastry dough.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals in Minutes
programs.desc: Rachael prepares sautéed red shrimp with homemade stock, served over a vibrant vegetable salad. John mixes a Pre-Prohibition Martini with a spicy kick, and Rachael's friend, Giancarla, joins her to make a tray of delicious baked large shell pasta.

programs.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
programs.desc: The master of flipping, James Dainard, and longtime rival Jared decide to bury the hatchet and partner on a 100-year-old zombie house trashed by squatters. The property has huge potential, but it's in rough shape and needs a full overhaul-including restoring its original character and finishing the entire basement to push the value well past a million dollars. James has a strict plan to keep the numbers on track, but Jared is notorious for blowing budgets on high-end finishes.

programs.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
programs.desc: James Dainard is faced with a big dilemma, do flipping and friendship go together?; his longtime friend Carrie, friend to his wife Clair, has fallen on some tough times and wants James' help; recently divorced and eager for financial freedom, Carrie convinces James she can handle the project even though she is a complete novice; together, they tackle a mid-century modern disaster with an unfinished basement, small kitchen, and a single main-floor bathroom.

programs.title: Million Dollar Zombie Flips
programs.desc: James Dainard's grandparents have recently passed, and together with his mom, Claire, James must help decide the future of the family home. The house is full of memories but also outdated, with a small kitchen and a layout that doesn't showcase its views. Working with his team—construction manager Ryan and designer and realtor Megan—James aims to renovate and restore the home for top dollar.
